instruction: The software choices can be launched from: Revit 2025: C:\Program Files\Autodesk\Revit 2025\Revit.exe; Archicad 27: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; Abaqus 2025: C:\SIMULIA\EstProducts\2025\win_b64\resources\install\cmdDirFeature\launcher.bat. Open-choice CLI requirement: Revit 2025, Archicad 27, and Abaqus 2025 are available at the paths listed above. Choose an appropriate tool and its command-line or official automation workflow from these three to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and save the completed model deliverable into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected tool workflow. The current model is a single-storey workshop and small loading building with simple industrial roof forms. The operator wants a clearly registered parcel pickup corner near the loading side without changing the outer envelope or the existing service rooms. Add the pickup zone and the associated service door record so operations can manage customer collection separately from workshop activity.
